notes: Sup’ung Dam’s 899.5 m gravity wall, 26 spillway bays, three crest gantries, five sealed log sluices, the seven-section powerhouse and both concrete abutments. The model preserves the mapped placement and documented concrete wall height. In the sampled-water fixture the upstream water lies about 35–43 m below the operating pool, exposing much more of the upstream wall. The standard Terrarium field contains isolated anomalous elevations at the apron and nearby shore. The raw source terrain is preserved and runtime site acceptance remains pending. Gate settings, the closed log sluice panels and the powerhouse facade are exterior reconstructions. The separately mapped service building and the downstream road and rail crossing remain native.
